newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends near day's high as Dow jumps.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends near day's high as Dow jumps.

text.p: UK shares finished with solid gains on Monday, as investors shrugged off a weak gilts market and tumbling European bourses and instead looked to Wall Street, where the Dow scaled new peaks, dealers said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 share index closed 41.4 points higher at 4,686.7, just 7.6 points off its May 16 record finish. FTSE 100 advancers beat decliners 71 to 29.
The Dow was up 54 points when London markets closed, after jumping about 130 points on Friday following the release of the U.S. May employment report.
